fullDesc: On July 8, 2014 Germany beat host Brazil 7-1 in the World Cup semifinal in Belo Horizonte. Five of Germany's goals came in a 29-minute span in the first half.
realFacts: It was Brazil's heaviest ever defeat at a World Cup
Germany went on to win the tournament
Miroslav Klose broke the World Cup scoring record
The loss is known in Brazil as the Mineirazo
